summary: Wrote a 12-phase implementation plan for the generic schema-validity layer. No research round was needed: the repository already documents this exact refactoring pattern twice (Semantics/ValidityLayer.lean and Semantics/TruthClauses.lean), and direct reads confirmed StabClauses instances exist for PlusFormula, StarFormula, OpenFormula and HybridFormula, so the generic layer serves more consumers than the task description assumed. Both recorded obstructions were confirmed: openTruthAt_timeShift is landed but time shift stays outside the clause layer by the existing contract, so modal_future takes the homogeneity fact as an explicit hypothesis; and the linearity asymmetry is two distinct axes (genuine nesting for CN/BX7, disjunct order only for TL/BX11), so the plan supplies all four variant pairs. The plan validates clean under validate-artifact.sh --strict.

artifacts.summary: 12-phase plan, 19.5h, 10 dependency waves; new module FormalSystem/Metalogic/SoundnessLemmas/GenericSchemata.lean plus clause-interface extensions and three per-language rewires.
